pairing-grant.thisSingleUseDocumentAutho: This single-use document authorizes one desktop client or manually installed Worker. Share it only with your intended device; it expires five minutes after server issuance.
pairing-grant.issuanceWasAcknowledgedWit: Issuance was acknowledged without a matching grant. Inspect the original pairing request; no replacement was issued.
pairing-grant.pairingDocumentWasUsedItsP: Pairing document was used. Its private code has been cleared.
pairing-grant.pairingDocumentExpiredItsP: Pairing document expired. Its private code has been cleared.
pairing-grant.singleUseGrantIssuedTheLat: Single-use grant issued; the latest read has no paired device.
pairing-grant.grantIssuedCurrentUseStatu: Grant issued; current use status is unavailable.
pairing-grant.theGrantObservationNoLonge: The grant observation no longer matches the original issuance.
pairing-grant.copyTheSelectedDocumentToT: Copy the selected document to the intended device. It remains private when this settings area closes.
pairing-grant.theSelectedServerChangedTh: The selected server changed. This original grant cannot be shared or retried through another connection.
pairing-grant.discardingClearsThisWindow: Discarding clears this window's private copy; an already-issued grant remains valid until used or expired. Closing this server window also discards the copy.
